orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPSS No. 1100 of 2020
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
 Mr. M.C. Tiwari, Dy. A.G. with Mr. 
Virendra Singh Rawat, Brief Holder for the 
State. 
Heard. 
As prayed, four weeks’ time is granted to 
learned Government pleader to file counter 
affidavit. 
List thereafter. 
No ground to grant interim relief to the 
petitioner is made out at this stage. Interim 
relief application (CLMA 7715 of 2020) is, 
therefore, dismissed. 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
mamta 25.09.2020

WPSS No. 1100 of 2020
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. S.M.S. Mehta, Brief Holder for 
the State/respondents.
Counter affidavit is taken on record. 
I.A. No. 7716 of 2021 stands disposed of 
accordingly.
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
seeks time to file rejoinder affidavit.
Let it be done within three weeks.
List thereafter for final hearing.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 05.08.2021
Avneet/

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1100 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Additional CSC, 
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Respondent No.3, has filed the counter 
affidavit, to which the learned counsel for the 
petitioner has filed the rejoinder affidavit 
through IA No.7717 of 2021, the same would 
stand allowed. Rejoinder affidavit is taken on 
record.
Looking to the nature of the relief which 
has been claimed i.e. for the grant of parity of 
scale based on the Government Orders issued 
by respondent No.1, and the arrears thereof. In 
order to better decide the matter, the counter 
affidavit of respondent Nos.1 and 2 i.e. State 
becomes necessary.
Ms. Anjali Bhargava, Additional CSC, 
prays for and is granted three weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit in the matter on behalf of 
respondent Nos.1 and 2.
List thereafter. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 23.10.2021
NR/
